title: OpenVeil: Detect, verify and mosaic people in video datasets before release, with an interactive human review tool
description:
OpenVeil helps researchers release video datasets that show people. It proposes person boxes with an open-vocabulary detector (Grounding DINO), verifies them with a fine-tuned crop classifier (a LoRA adapter and MLP head on DINOv3 ViT-L/16), lets a human check the hard cases in a local review tool, and mosaics the people while re-encoding only the parts of each video that contain a mosaic (smart cut).

It was built to release the Calf-Play-Behavior-Dataset (version 1.2, DOI 10.57967/hf/11689), a calf play-behaviour dataset of 1,173 videos from two farms.

The code is under Apache-2.0. The crop verifier weights are not part of this archive: they are published separately on Hugging Face under the DINOv3 License. Built with DINOv3.
